entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs RLC bearer release procedures as specified in the 3GPP specification.

entities.name: RLC Bearer Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE releases RLC entities and corresponding logical channels based on configuration lists or SCG release.

entities.name: RLC Entity
entities.description: Radio Link Control entity that handles segmentation and retransmission for logical channels.

entities.name: Logical Channel
entities.description: A channel between RLC and MAC layers identified by logicalChannelIdentity.

entities.name: rlc-BearerToReleaseList
entities.description: List containing logicalChannelIdentity values indicating which RLC bearers should be released.

entities.name: SCG Release Condition
entities.description: Condition where RLC bearer release occurs as a result of Secondary Cell Group release.

relations.description: The UE performs the RLC bearer release procedure when triggered by configuration or SCG release.
The procedure uses the rlc-BearerToReleaseList to determine which logical channels to release.
The procedure can be triggered by SCG release condition.
The procedure results in release of RLC entities as specified in TS 38.322.
The procedure results in release of corresponding logical channels.
